name: Rubber and soft PVC (kind 8) and woven webbing (kind 14, new)
kind: surface kind 8 in BOAT_CODE (RUBBER_WEAR block, with an Age; unset as before) and new kind 14 (WEBBING_WEAR block); M_BoatKit's Rubrail slot through the same rubber lines
code: scripts/make_materials.py BOAT_CODE, the blocks between '// RUBBER_WEAR >>>' / '<<<' and '// WEBBING_WEAR >>>' / '<<<'; scripts/import_hardware_kit.py KIT_CODE copies RUBBER_WEAR

boats.j22: hero J/22 RubRail (grey PVC hull-deck strip) and ExtensionBlack (tiller extension grip) kind 8; spare vests' straps Webbing now kind 14 (was 11, canvas)
boats.sunfish, ilca: the hiking strap moves from the Rubber slot to the new Webbing slot (kind 14, its own slot: every pack is full); the daggerboard gasket and the extension's joint stay Rubber
boats.fleet: library Rubrail and Rubber on every built boat with Age and Care (custom data 10 and 11)

pattern_size_cm.ozone_crack: 0.35 cm apart along the part, up to 0.8 cm long, 0.2-0.6 mm wide
pattern_size_cm.dock_rash: 6 cm cells along the part, 0.35 cm high, streak 20-90% of the cell
pattern_size_cm.webbing_weave: the canvas detail normal at 2 cm (High; no new map)

levels_needed.L0: satin black rubber, black woven webbing, clean grey PVC
levels_needed.L1: as new; a stray dock scuff on the rail
levels_needed.L2: a waxy grey-brown bloom on the sun side (rail top L* about 30), dock rash streaks, dust; the strap faded to charcoal, fuzzy, gritty
levels_needed.L3: kept: darker satin bloom wiped with protectant, fine ozone cracks across the rubber, no dust or mildew; the strap replaced every 8 years, so only part-faded
levels_needed.L4: heavy pale bloom (L* about 37), more cracks, tan dust, mildew specks; the strap bleached brown-grey, fuzzy, frayed at the edges, black mildew clusters

drivers: rubber: bloom = timeK (0.3 + 1.2 dirtK) x sky x sun, weight 0.85 - 0.6 Care, rough to 0.92 (left) or 0.62 (kept); cracks smoothstep(0.45, 0.85, timeK) x (1 - 0.6 Care); dock rash share 0.6 saturate(3 timeK) + 0.1 dirtK on upright faces; dust and mildew on dirtK. webbing: wbTime = timeK x (1 - 0.5 kept x saturate(age/8)); fade, fuzz, grit, frayed edges (curvature), mildew. Age unset (-1): the old lines exactly.
replaces: kind 8 had one line (col + 0.05 ageK, rough to 0.85); webbing had no kind of its own (the dinghy strap was Rubber, the hero's vest straps canvas)
maps: none new: shader math; kind 8 keeps T_Detail_Rubber_N, kind 14 reuses T_Detail_Canvas_N at a 2 cm tile on High
out_of_scope: the crew's vest webbing (MI_Crew_Webbing, CrewStraps) is the crew gear fabric pass; the marks' webbing handles (CrewStraps) and the Lagoon's tender tubes stay as they are; fenders and dock lines are their own pass
